name: hamster
description: Orchestrates Hamster Studio brief execution with team personas, parallel wave execution, and deep review modes. Ask Hamster over hosted MCP; setup, ship, plan, resume, review, QA, and retro.

interface.longDescription: Hamster is an AI-native product planning workspace where humans and AI teammates share context, align on briefs, and ship together. Hamster writes the specs your coding agent executes: briefs hold the decision, plans hold the tasks with acceptance criteria and dependencies, and both sync into the repo as markdown under .hamster/, so no session starts cold. The plugin adds skills for setup, ship, plan, resume, review, QA, and retro, and connects to Hamster's hosted MCP server for briefs, tasks, plans, and workspace knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Ship the brief I'm assigned to
Ask Hamster what the team decided about this file
